title: Lost CAN frames
hints: Run the starter first: the simulator stops it because the ISR burns CPU. Move the work to the task. The ISR should only *signal*. Then look at what happens in a burst.

The ISR calls `rtos_sem_give(rx_sem)`. One slot (`max = 1`) forgets frames that arrive while the handler is busy, so make it a counting semaphore with room for `MAX_BURST`. Then give the handler a priority above the display (2).
`void can_rx_isr(void) { rtos_sem_give(rx_sem); }`, `rx_sem = rtos_sem_create(0, MAX_BURST);` and `rtos_task_create("can_rx", can_rx_task, NULL, 3);`
